UPP.duration: 2 semesters (one academic year, per UPP page); up to 26 classroom hours per week
UPP.intakes: Oct 2026 (5 Oct 2026-9 Jul 2027); Jan 2027 (4 Jan-20 Aug 2027); Oct 2027 (5 Oct 2027-9 Jul 2028); Jan 2028 (4 Jan-20 Aug 2028). Progresses to undergraduate study Sep-27 / Sep-28
UPP.fee: EUR 22,980 (2026/27 intakes); EUR 24,180 (2027/28 intakes); plus EUR 450 registration fee; fees subject to change
UPP.academic: Successful completion of High School (country-specific requirements in Coursefinder)
UPP.maths: OMPT / maths test not mentioned on Entry requirements or UPP pages. Degree pages: UvA BSc Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, Econometrics and Data Science, Economics and Business Economics say 'Additional Maths entrance test may be required'
UPP.progression_text: Centre page: 'With 30-60 ECTS credits, students have guaranteed progression to Year 2 at Wittenborg University of Applied Sciences.' 'With 60 ECTS credits, students can also apply to research universities in the Netherlands and beyond.' UPP page: designed with Wittenborg to deliver the Propaedeutic Year 1; successful students may apply to transfer to research universities.

MQP.duration: 2 semesters on Dates and fees page; MQP page says one academic year (nine months), up to 25 hours of classes per week
MQP.intakes: 24 Aug 2026-25 Jun 2027 (to postgraduate study Sep-27); 24 Aug 2027-25 Jun 2028 (to Sep-28)
MQP.fee: EUR 26,970 (2026/27); EUR 28,380 (2027/28); plus EUR 450 registration fee; fees subject to change
MQP.english: 6.0 IELTS or equivalent (with no single element less than 5.5)
MQP.academic: Academic Bachelor Degree in a related subject and with good grades; minimum age 21+. Economics pathway: GRE all sections with 155 Quantitative Reasoning, or GMAT with Quantitative 48. Business pathway: GMAT if degree unrelated or limited quantitative research methods content, subject to university's assessment
MQP.maths: OMPT not mentioned. GRE/GMAT quantitative requirements as stated under academic
MQP.progression_text: MQP page: 'offers successful students guaranteed progression' to postgraduate degrees at the University of Amsterdam; 'Guaranteed progression is subject to meeting the specified entry criteria.' Pathways: Business, Accountancy and Control, Data Science and Business Analytics, Economics, Econometrics.

partners.guarantee: MQP page: 'offers successful students guaranteed progression' to postgraduate degrees at the University of Amsterdam; 'Guaranteed progression is subject to meeting the specified entry criteria.' No guarantee wording on the UvA degrees page itself.
